signal_rows.label: Trace signal
notes: Trace spans keep manifest-rooted structure and explicit sampling posture.
Compliance-significant spans never rely on best-effort drop logic.

signal_rows.label: Metric signal
notes: Operational metrics remain distinct from audit proof.

signal_rows.label: Log signal
notes: Structured logs are schema-aligned and redaction-safe by default.
General logs may not become a shadow audit system.

signal_rows.label: HTTP propagation
notes: Public HTTP ingress may contribute transport trace continuity only.

signal_rows.label: Queue propagation
notes: Queue dispatch and consume preserve safe manifest/workflow anchors.
Malformed baggage must fail closed without losing safe correlation.

signal_rows.label: Stream propagation
notes: Stream publication may correlate through hashed resume bindings only.
Raw resume tokens remain transport material and stay out of telemetry.

signal_rows.label: Client surface telemetry
notes: Browser-owned telemetry is limited to shell, route, posture, module, action, timing, preference, and opaque refs.
Copied UI text, filenames, screenshots, DOM snapshots, and masked values remain forbidden.
